verdict.rationale: ELSTER's business info page states up front that paperless filing requires a free, one-time registration in Mein ELSTER, which issues a certificate for signature-free electronic submission. It also states that a new business must first apply for its tax number electronically via the registration questionnaire. These are first-party, pre-flow disclosures of the account and credential gate, but they do not spell out the identity-proofing steps in detail. Missing for 10: an explicit step-by-step listing of the identity-proofing and activation process, any timing or delivery details for credential issuance, and independent or hands-on corroboration that no further walls appear mid-flow.
